annotations.title: Register a shop for the comparison

description: One call registers a shop (P01): name, domain, delivery country, contact e-mail, the feed (its address in `feed_url`, or the file in `feed_content` / `feed_base64`), how commission is paid and the accepted partner terms version. An address is read at once through the SSRF guard (public hosts only, 422 url_rejected otherwise) with a 12 s cap; a file is decoded (at most 8 MB, gzip allowed, ZIP refused: 422 upload_zip_unsupported, 413 upload_too_large) and only its sha-256 and size are kept. Either way the feed is diagnosed (P04) and the 202 answer carries `feed.health` ok | warn | fail with the top three issues; the full report is stored on the request, `feed_source` says url or upload. One open request per domain: a second call updates it and answers the same id with `duplicate: true`; a declined domain may register again. The contact gets the `shop_registration_received` mail (its language: `locale`, else the country's default) with the confirmation link and the status page; the operator gets one notice. `verification.ownership` carries the token for the meta tag or file proof (verify_shop_domain). A shop on the ČOI / SOI risk list is refused (403). A registration never lists a shop by itself: the operator decides. A shop registered with a file only is listed as still being added until it sends a feed address. Follow it with get_shop_registration. Six calls a minute per caller.

accept_terms.description: true = the contact accepts the partner terms of the given version.

affiliate.description: How commission is paid: "own" = forDeal's own programme (5 % of the net order value, partner portal), a network name the country lists (ehub, cj, awin, dognet, …), "other", or "none".

country.description: Delivery country of the shop, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 from GET /api/v1/deals/countries.

domain.description: The shop's domain or URL, e.g. www.obchod.cz.

email.description: Contact e-mail of the shop; it receives the confirmation link and the decision. Never shown.

feed_base64.description: The feed file's bytes as base64, for a gzip-packed file (.xml.gz, .csv.gz). ZIP is refused: unpack it first.

feed_content.description: The feed as a file instead of an address: the XML or CSV text itself (at most 8 MB). Checked once and dropped; only its sha-256 and size are kept. Regular price updates still need a feed_url later.

feed_filename.description: The uploaded file's name, kept with its fingerprint.

feed_url.description: The product feed (Heureka, Zboží, Google Merchant, Ceneo, Idealo, Árukereső XML or CSV). Read at once; the answer carries the diagnostics report. Public hosts only. Either this or a file.

locale.description: Language of the mails (cs, sk, en, …); the country's default language when absent.

shop_name.description: The shop's name as it should appear in the comparison.

terms_version.description: The partner terms version being accepted; today 2026-10-09 (the terms are at /partner/smlouva).

website.description: Leave empty (spam trap: a filled value is discarded quietly).
